      • authorizeRequestedGroup

        public void authorizeRequestedGroup(String userToken,
                                    String requestedGroup)
                             throws ParseException,
                                    ForbiddenException
        Check if there is a group claim in user's token and verify that the group requested by the user is in the user's allowed groups.
        Parameters:
        userToken - user's token
        requestedGroup - group requested by the user
        Throws:
        ParseException - if the claim value is not of required type when parsing user's token
        ForbiddenException - if there is no groups or wlcg groups claim, or they are both empty, or the requested group is not in the user's allowed groups
